answer: A farm running 191 keys hence pays that exposure 191 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. The ripple escrow holds each stake, the knoll settlement releases it, and the harbor audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 13% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
